summary: The candidate implementation itself rejected a structurally valid unrelated PNG and accepted the independently rerendered page 1 of the same hash-pinned PDF at 160 DPI. All four substantive raw-response bindings, the prior malformed-container crashes, the specified decision boundaries, and updater rollback are now directly controlled and their representative contract mutants were killed. One mutation-completeness issue remains: the committed PDF test only compares two hashes and never asserts the validator's render-binding branch, allowing three behavior-changing PDF provenance mutants to leave all 92 declared controls green.

findings.title: The PDF render-binding control does not exercise the validator and permits wrong predicate, page, and DPI mutants
findings.contract: Every PDF-derived exactText row must be bound after lock to the deterministic full-page PNG rerendered from the same hash-pinned PDF, declared 1-based page, and locked 160 DPI; the mutation suite must fail if that binding is removed or redirected.

evidence.detail: The contract requires the same source PDF, declared page index, locked 160 DPI, and byte-identical rerender; an unrelated valid PNG is explicitly forbidden.

The current implementation hash-checks the PDF, rerenders the declared page with pdftoppm, and requires the evidence PNG hash to equal the rerender hash when seals are enforced. The direct probe confirmed this implementation behavior.

The named PDF control calls rendered_pdf_page_sha256() and only asserts that its return differs from the synthetic fixture PNG. It never invokes validate() or asserts the deterministic-render-binding diagnostic.
The nearby enforce-seals test asserts only the unrelated uncommitted-artifact diagnostic, so it remains green when the PDF render predicate is inverted or the rerender is redirected.

directCurrentCodeProbe.observed: The unrelated PNG had zero PNG-structure failures and produced exactly one deterministic-render-binding failure. An independent pdftoppm rerender matched the helper hash and produced zero render-binding failures.

survivingMutants.name: pdf-invert-render-match
survivingMutants.contractEffect: An unrelated PNG satisfies the render predicate while the exact rerender does not.

survivingMutants.name: pdf-rerender-next-page
survivingMutants.mutation: Render page_index + 1 for both pdftoppm page bounds.
survivingMutants.contractEffect: A PNG of the next page can satisfy evidence that declares the preceding page.

survivingMutants.name: pdf-rerender-wrong-dpi
survivingMutants.mutation: Render at dpi + 1 instead of the declared locked DPI.
survivingMutants.contractEffect: A PNG rendered at a different DPI can satisfy a row declaring 160 DPI.

findings.minimalCorrection: Replace or extend the PDF control with a public-validator test under enforce_seals=true that (1) supplies a structurally valid unrelated PNG and asserts the deterministic-render-binding failure, then (2) independently invokes pdftoppm for the declared PDF/page/DPI, supplies those bytes, and asserts that this binding failure is absent. Add adjacent-page and wrong-DPI PNG negatives. Do not derive the expected positive bytes through rendered_pdf_page_sha256(), because that would preserve the page/DPI self-reference that allowed the latter two mutants to survive.

controlResults.evidence: Direct public-validator probe rejected the unrelated valid PNG and accepted an independently rerendered same-PDF page at 160 DPI; three contract mutants nevertheless survived all 92 committed controls.
Completeness, blind, comparator, and verification unrelated-but-hash-pinned response tests each failed when its equality binding was disabled.

controlResults.area: Malformed containers and non-object top levels
controlResults.evidence: The committed table covers the five prior nested container cases, separate unhashable IDs, and non-object manifest/progress inputs. Packet, comparison, and top-object short-circuit mutants were killed by errors in the direct controls.

Exactly-two, three-same-family recurrence, authority override, hidden default, and affected-family mutants were each killed by focused decision tests; the suite also retains the exactly-three and two-family recurrence negatives.
The updater-level test forced validation failure and asserted byte-for-byte restoration; deleting PROGRESS.write_bytes(original) was killed.

testsRun.result: Structurally valid unrelated PNG rejected at the render binding; independent same-PDF page-1 160-DPI render accepted at that binding
16 mutants executed: 13 killed by direct controls; 3 PDF render-binding mutants survived all 92 mutation tests
